decisions.text:
Decisions for Paul (details on the Spec sheet, §3):
D1 Gold: drawn #DDB844; alt #EFB63B. Flip in Tweaks → Gold.
D2 Privacy/Terms in nav: drawn no. Flip in Tweaks → Nav.
D3 Pricing section: drawn in, one button.
D4 Motion: re-decided. Signature moment on the crest + once-only reveals + chrome. Needs a written fourth motion class and brand sign-off on the mask and light.
D5 CTA case: sentence case.
D6 Phone: 390.
D7 Footer Documentation link: dropped.
D8 Tagline: kept once, at the close; the claim check flagged it against ai.md.
D9 Hero: A crest (drawn), B thread, C type, D phone. Recommendation B. Boards to the right of the phone.

fold.text: Fold: a 1440×900 viewport ends here. Nav, hero, crest and the officer strip all sit above it. Hero LCP is the H1; the crest is an inline SVG, not an image. The crest wipe, settle, light and rule play once on open (motion-safe).

frames.text: Product frames are drawn on product tokens (web --primary #DDB844, the §2 ladder) and do not follow the Gold tweak. They show what ships: Check in on the event card, no RSVP, no Ask pill. The desktop frame is an officer's view, which is why it shows the live count.

heropick.text: D9 · Which hero. A (crest, on the Desktop board) is the brief's crest-editorial hero and carries the signature moment. B puts the proof at the fold: the officer's chat with the event card, bleeding off the right edge; the crest keeps the closing and the lockup. C is all type: a 96px H1 across twelve columns and a three-row ledger of what ships; the crest is a 40px mark on the eyebrow rule. D is the member's phone, the locked s04 chat home, cropped at the fold. Recommendation: B, with the signature moment moving to the closing crest. Each option keeps the nav, copy, CTAs and officer strip identical so only the visual is being judged.
